question: Estimate the annual market for second-hand smartphone sales (refurbished + used) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Both organized (Cashify, Yaantra, OLX) and unorganized? Yes — total category.
Refurbished by brands (Apple Certified, Samsung) included? Yes.
B2B (mobile recycling for parts) excluded? Yes — only consumer resale.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: total smartphone units sold/replaced annually → resale rate → average resale value.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Smartphone replacement cycle in India: ~30-36 months.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, devices that get resold (rather than retained/discarded)

calculationFlow: Of these, devices that get resold (rather than retained/discarded): ~30% = 75M.
Of the 75M, organized resale share: ~25% = ~19M (rest unorganized — local dealer, OLX, family).
